_readme: Hand-written relation probe, phrased differently from the generator's FIR templates. Names are fictional.
Written before the relation rules. Scored once with oracle entities; rules are not edited to fix misses here.
entities: [text, type] in order of appearance. expected: [edge type, source node id, target node id]; EVENT = the document's incident.
Only pattern relations are listed; same-sentence ASSOCIATED_WITH edges are scored separately.
